hypothesis: Beta-binomial author weighting improves 90:10 accuracy over market and fixed 90:10 on common retrospectively eligible events
data: all available raw old/new vote records plus standard-ot frames; do not infer missing identity, timestamps or independence
identity: construct transitive components on all raw records before publication filtering, using same normalized site+author, canonical URL, exact document/body hash, and explicit cross-citation links when present; then pregame claimed publication only, earliest per component per event; exclude conflicts and missing identity/time
settlement: only outcomes from strictly earlier calendar days proxy settlement availability; no verified historical settlement clock; freeze parameters using train only before validation/test
split: sort common eligible event kickoff chronologically, first 50% train, next 25% validation, last 25% test, avoid splitting same date
selection: maximum validation accuracy on common opportunities; tie first candidate; no test tuning
baselines: market and original actual fixed 90:10 vote share from frame, 4-decimal rounding; weighted 90:10 same rounding
metrics: coverage, n, accuracy, single unit ROI, disagreement subset, independent vote counts, posterior beta 95% interval, paired weekly bootstrap accuracy and ROI differences for both baselines; 2000 replicates seed 20261030, Bonferroni simultaneous intervals alpha=0.05/3 across candidates
leakage: claimed publication < kickoff; exclude postgame and unknown; no final odds or labels in features; test label flips leave training parameters and predictions unchanged; prices historical not certified; conservative prior-day settlement proxy not authenticated
interpretation: all data previously exposed, not blind holdout; no inference about future performance or executable odds; no independent author claim without evidence
reproducibility: committed input/source/result SHA256; independent second settlement implementation exact agreement; offline replay
amendment_before_experiment: User instructed prior-calendar-day plus 48h embargo; require historical kickoff+48h <= training boundary and historical date strictly before boundary date. Settlement remains assumed, not authenticated. Strict certified branch has zero eligible observations. Parameters frozen at train boundary for validation and test.
